title: The Schizoid and the Oracle
narrativeSpine: Information access differs from formed judgment; a revisable ideology must anticipate capture by its own fluent interpreters.
firstSceneDraft: The Schizoid and the Oracle asks how an ideology might resist its own capture.
This philosophical investigation begins with the distance between information and formed judgment.
Its title uses a cognitive archetype, explicitly not a medical diagnosis.
Fluent answers can arrive before someone can defend or limit their authority.
visualActionProposal: A public doorway becomes an answer terminal, then an assembly with an accessible dissenting entrance; coral, turquoise and violet, with warm expressive readers.
